react_native_issues.issue: Browser console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking. Reference: appears on every dashboard render. Migrate any pointerEvents= prop to style={{ pointerEvents: 'none'|'auto' }}.

action_items: (optional/non-blocking) Migrate any remaining props.pointerEvents usages to style.pointerEvents to silence RN-Web deprecation warning.

(minor/preexisting) test_spec_v2.py::TestClassification::test_classify_logic fails with ModuleNotFoundError('services') when run from /app — cwd-dependent import. Consider adding backend/ to sys.path in a conftest.py, or run pytest with rootdir=/app/backend. Not related to this iteration.

(nice-to-have) Consider guarding _periodic_sync with an asyncio.Lock to prevent overlap with manual /api/sync calls; currently two syncs could race and inflate counts (server.py:280 wipe-then-insert is not concurrency-safe).

(nice-to-have) In dashboard.by_bdm, currently sort key is (placed, freight) desc — zero-activity reps still appear but grouped at bottom; consider adding a 'has_activity' flag for the UI to visually deprioritise or collapse them.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:502-508 correctly filters status.lower()=='placed' for totals.{freight,costing,gm2}. total_weight still uses ALL demand_rows — this is intentional per spec ('raised weight' is separate from 'placed financials'), verified in dashboard.tsx which does not surface weight_mt in the FINANCIALS·PLACED ONLY block.

server.py:517-557 by_bdm construction: adds zero-activity reps only when at least one email had activity (bdm_agg is non-empty). Edge case: on a completely-quiet day (bdm_agg={}), by_bdm returns []; the frontend gracefully hides the team-breakdown card (dashboard.tsx:247 checks length>0). Confirmed behaviour is acceptable.

server.py:874-883 _periodic_sync — creates a background task in @app.on_event('startup'). Uvicorn's --workers>1 mode would spawn one task per worker (redundant syncs). In this environment supervisor runs a single worker, so no duplication observed. Document this constraint if scaling out.
dashboard.tsx:186-206 chartTop shows only t.raised — the placed count is only visible as bar height. Consider adding a secondary small label for placed count for accessibility.
dashboard.tsx:250 by_bdm sort is server-side; the UI does not re-sort. If E1 wants zero-activity reps hidden by default, add a toggle.
